name: email-client-v2
description: A private inbox on Cloudflare Workers — Vite SPA + Hono API, set up from the browser.

scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Your inbox: messages, labels, aliases, and all app configuration. Name it after your mail domain (e.g. example-com-driftmail) — a D1 database cannot be renamed later.

EMAIL_CACHE.description: Raw .eml files and attachments. Name it to match your database.

EMAIL.description: Outbound mail, if you choose Cloudflare as your sending provider.
